changelog:
**Initial release of the Email Formatter skill with robust security requirements.**

- Transforms rough email drafts into polished, professional messages, improving grammar, tone, and formatting.
- Detects trigger phrases such as "format my email," "make this professional," and requests to improve or polish email drafts.
- Supports adjusting tone (formal/casual/friendly), converting bullet points or notes to full emails, and preparing messages for important recipients.
- Features automatic and manual installation instructions, with optional support for advanced language tools.
- Implements multi-layered, maximum-level security and safety validation—including blocking of illegal, sensitive, or high-risk content—before any formatting is performed.
- Provides compliance warnings for detected personal, financial, or sensitive information in emails.
summary: Transform rough email drafts into polished, professional messages. Use this skill when the user wants to improve email quality, fix grammar and tone, format business emails, or convert casual messages into professional communication. Triggers include: 'format my email', 'make this professional', 'improve this message', 'fix my email', 'polish this draft', or any request to enhance email writing quality. Also use when converting bullet points or notes into complete emails, adjusting tone (formal/casual/friendly), or preparing important messages for clients, managers, or stakeholders.
